step.prompt: /crew-architecture Design Teamly from docs/03 using the python-fastapi-react preset: FastAPI + Postgres backend, React/Vite frontend, one cloud. Do not ask questions. Write docs/05-architecture.md, docs/09-data-model.md, docs/10-api-contract.md, contracts/openapi.yaml, docs/13-conventions.md and at least two ADRs in docs/adr/, then list the specs to write in build order, and finish.
step.judge: Read docs/05-architecture.md, docs/09-data-model.md, docs/10-api-contract.md, contracts/openapi.yaml, docs/13-conventions.md and docs/adr/*. Score 5 if containers and flows are diagrammed, layers have an allowed-imports table with the domain pure and ports/adapters named, the data model has entities with IDs, tenancy and state tables, the OpenAPI file is valid-looking YAML with auth, errors with stable codes and the P0 resources, ADRs follow context/options/decision/consequences with honest trade-offs and pinned versions, and a build-order list of specs exists. Score 3 if the shape is right but values are vague ('the latest'). Score 1 if it is prose without contracts.

judge.reason: docs/05 has Mermaid container and sequence diagrams plus a 16-spec build-order table; docs/13 has a backend allowed-imports table with a pure domain and named ports/adapters; docs/09 has an ER diagram, per-entity ID/tenancy/state tables and constraints; contracts/openapi.yaml parses (3.1.0, 17 paths) with a cookie security scheme, a Problem schema enumerating 13 stable codes and every P0 resource; the three ADRs follow context/options/decision/consequences with explicit Bad consequences and [assumed] markers, though exact versions are major-only (SQLAlchemy 2, Python 3.12) and deferred to the lockfile.
